title: AP Style Guide
summary: General style points Sentences Please avoid beginning a sentence with an Arabic numeral – e.g. ‘30 years ago’ should be written ‘Thirty years ago’. Please note that when numbers are written out they should be hyphenated. E.g. Seventy-six trombones led the big parade… – Not: seventy six trombones… Abbreviations Please define all abbreviations on first usage, using the format: ‘The decision taken by Arts Council England (ACE)…’ ‘Incorporated’ as part of an organisation’s title is shown as just ‘inc’ Ltd does not take a final point as it is a contraction not an abbreviation. title: About the Arts Pay Survey
summary: Thank you for participating in Arts Pay 2025, a comprehensive longitudinal survey about working conditions in the arts and cultural sector. This research, conducted by Arts Professional and Baker Richards, builds on our 2018 and 2022 surveys to explore how people experience work in the arts today – from access and precarity to equity and workplace culture. Why this matters: We’re examining how societal shifts and structural factors shape who gets to work in the arts, who gets to stay, and what it takes to thrive.
